messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Simon Chan <simon.chan@vectra.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & numbers request — dedicated capacity fit for Vectra.ai

Hi Simon — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a few asks so we can prepare a tailored reserved-capacity proposal.

Summary of what I heard:
- Workload: interactive chat + periodic bulk embeddings generation for search reindexing.
- Target production traffic: fairly spiky throughout the day, expected 100M tokens/month in Q3 with a 2x peak-to-average.
- SLOs: p95 latency target ~200ms for short-turn chat requests (few hundred tokens).
- Security: private tenancy preferred (Dedicated or Private later), but for now you're evaluating Dedicated reserved lanes.

As next steps, could you confirm just three quick items so we can model unit economics:
1) Target monthly token volume (best guess OK) — you mentioned ~100M, please confirm.
2) Budget range for inference (ballpark $/1M tokens you’d consider).
3) Any hard constraints on GPU family (e.g., must be A100, or H100 allowed) or procurement/finance cadence that affects term lengths.

I attached a short econ workbook we use internally — fill the top section (volume + desired $/1M) and we’ll produce a sensitivity table and a recommended reserved-lanes configuration.

Planned internal owners: I’ll loop in Rishi (perf sizing) and Marissa (pricing/contract) once we have the numbers.

Thanks — Naomi

--

Thanks Naomi — appreciate the clear recap. Confirming the numbers from our side:
- Best current estimate: 100M tokens/month (chat + embeddings combined) in steady state; Q3 ramp could push to 150M depending on adoption.
- Budget: rough internal target is $250–$400 per 1M tokens (we know this is a wide band).
- GPU constraint: we prefer proven stability; A100s are our baseline comfort tier, but we can consider H100 for a higher throughput scenario if the unit economics make sense.
- Procurement: fiscal approvals run monthly but legal needs a 60-day review for any multi-month reserved commitment.

One more ask: what would a minimal pilot look like (e.g., 2–4 reserved lanes) and how quickly can we test throughput/latency in a short pilot to validate the assumptions?

Subject: RE: Fwd: Recap & numbers request — dedicated capacity fit for Vectra.ai

Quick sizing note (high-level — I'll plug numbers into the workbook tonight):
Assumptions:
- Typical chat request: 120 tokens median per response, 300 token worst-case; embedding jobs are batched and run off-peak.
- Model family targeted: opt-13b / open LLM variant used in discovery; quantized execution expected for A10G.

Throughput estimates (sustained, inference-only, auto-batching enabled, conservative kernels):
- A10G (16GB): ~180–260 tokens/sec per GPU (depends on quant and batch).
- A100 80GB: ~650–900 tokens/sec per GPU (much better KV cache/long-context handling).
- H100: ~900–1,300 tokens/sec per GPU (best for high throughput + long contexts).

For Vectra's ~100M tokens/month target:
- Peak planning: 2x peak-to-average -> design for ~2,200 tokens/sec sustained at peak (rough rough calc).
- Configs:
  - 2x A10G: 360–520 tokens/sec (underprovisioned for peak)
  - 4x A100: 2,600–3,600 tokens/sec (comfortably covers peak with headroom)
  - Mixed (2x A100 + 4x A10G): ~1,160–1,980 tokens/sec (may be marginal at peaks unless we rely on request shaping/caching)
\Recommendation: baseline reserved pool of 4x A100 for predictable latency headroom; offer a pilot with 2x A100 for an accelerated validation (can run perf tests and validate p95 latency).

Notes on economics: reserved A100 lanes at committed utilization and prefix caching can push effective $/1M down ~10–25% vs on-demand GPU usage in our hosted offering; exact numbers to follow from Marissa.

Attaching a quick perf matrix and a short note on assumptions.

-Rishi

Thanks — pulling numbers together here so we can send a clean proposal to Simon by EOD. Pricing sensitivity (ballpark, non-final):
- Basis: 100M tokens/month baseline; committed reserved lanes; 12-month term used for baseline math (we can shorten for pilot).
- Pricing bands (effective $/1M tokens after reserved-lane amortization + expected utilization):
  - 4x A100 reserved pool: $300–$340 per 1M tokens (range reflects 70–90% utilization assumptions and caching benefits)
  - Mixed 2x A100 + 4x A10G: $320–$370 per 1M tokens (efficiency loss from smaller GPUs + orchestration overhead)
  - 2x A10G pilot (short trial): $420–$520 per 1M tokens (pilot premium — we discount for term but pilots run lower utilization)

Pilot recommendation: offer a 60-day pilot (2x A100) with a 10% pilot discount on list reserved price and an option to convert to 4x A100 committed lanes with a credit for the pilot invoice. Procurement note: procurement requires 60 days for longer-term reserved commitments; propose a pilot start in June to align.

Next steps I will take if you both sign off:
- Draft a 1-page commercial summary with the three configs + sensitivity table for Simon.
- Pull standard reserved-lane T&Cs and a pilot order form for procurement.

Naomi — if that aligns with Rishi's perf assumptions, I'll finalize numbers and send externally.

-Marissa
